distribution.narrative: Lin et al. (2021) reports Shenzhen, Guangdong. Beaver & Liu (2010) provides a first Taiwan record from Chiayi, Zhongpu, 13.xii.1961. Guangdong and Taiwan are retained as current reviewed occurrence evidence from distinct sources.

host_note: The probable Litchi chinensis association from Lin et al. (2021) remains questionable. Beaver & Liu (2010) characterizes the species as strongly polyphagous but enumerates no host taxon in the curated record, so no additional host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Xyleborus ferrugineus (Fabricius, 1801).
